masking.note: every database sequence is searched; hits are then dropped for the query's own accession, its own sequence hash, its cluster_id and its partition. Database sequences outside the split registry are never masked by cluster or partition (they have none): the registry-only diagnostic arm and the identity bins show what that costs

query_latency.method: one mmseqs createdb + search + convertalis process set per query against the on-disk index: index loading is included, a resident server would be faster; nearest-rank percentiles; queries spread evenly over the length distribution

protocol.adr: ADR-0015 (protocol of ADR-0010, ADR-0011, ADR-0013 and ADR-0014)
protocol.selection_rule: hit filter: higher mean fold precision@primary_k, then higher mean fold Fmax, then the earlier grid point; partitions 1-4 only; the best-hit arm is tuned over top_k = 1 points
protocol.threshold_rule: one global threshold per arm, tuned for Fmax on the other partitions (nested, ADR-0011); the frozen threshold on partitions 1-4

frozen.scope_label: subset (500), not comparable to DeepLoc or to the Phase 8 full-corpus numbers
